title: Duecare harness chat — wheels
subtitle: v3.17 omni harness chat: 5 toggles + 4 grade modes + 9 model variants
description: v3.17 / chat-package 0.3.1 (2026-05-07) — 21-dim rubric, use-case-aware analog prompt classifier (multi-lingual: en/tl/id/ne/bn/my/ar/es/vi/si/ta/ur), curator-block JSON governance. v0.3.1: polish round — /api/harness-info now reports online=true if EITHER kernel-DDG OR a Brave key is configured (so the Online tile flips from NOT WIRED → OFF the moment a key is saved); Online modal save/clear immediately re-runs probeHarness; About modal updated to mention Brave BYOK + Import + keyboard shortcuts. Carries v0.3.0 Brave BYOK + keyboard shortcuts + sparse-category UX, v0.2.9 server-side import store with ZIP extraction, v0.2.8 per-step SSE progress. GREP rule set now ships 111 rules across 16 categories, including v3.17 digital-era additions for QR/mobile-wallet payment plans, side-letter two-contract deception, and digital credential-vault debt control. RAG corpus now ships 35 docs, including digital fee collection and side-letter deception briefs. Bundled wheels: duecare-llm-chat, duecare-llm-core, duecare-llm-models. Single CORE entry point: one configurable interface wiring every harness layer + 9 model variants (Gemma 4 E2B / E4B / 26B-A4B / 31B / 2 abliterated jailbroken / 3 cloud BYOK routes). Updates land here - bump this dataset version to refresh attached notebooks.
